provenance.review_method: Decoded timestamped frames across the full runtime at 1.0s spacing (1.5s for 04), plus supplied OCR/transcript; no continuous audio playback. Interval bounds are approximate.
adjudication_notes: Caption span is supported across the sampled runtime, but brief gaps cannot be ruled out; text coverage is partial.
Both B-roll intervals have supporting product cutaways; precise edit onset/end is approximate and other edits are unreviewed.
Proof is an interpretation of a speaker claim, not independent verification of compliments.
